description: Bring a high-level design (Markdown with Mermaid, a .mmd file, or a draw.io diagram) into Hunch and close its gaps with the human. action:"import" parses it deterministically and returns the questions protocol plus the first question; "next" returns the next open question; "answer" records the HUMAN's answer to one question (never your own guess; skip:true only when the human says to skip); "status" lists drafts or shows one. Ask ONE question at a time. Approval is human-only, in a terminal: hunch hld-approve <file> --reviewed-by <name>, which locks the design.

answer.description: for answer: the human's answer, in their words

cwd.description: Your current directory, when it differs from where this session started (e.g. a worktree); writes then commit there, not to the original root.

file.description: repo-relative HLD file (required except for status)

question_id.description: for answer: the question being answered

skip.description: for answer: the human chose to skip this question

name: hunch_hld
title: Import and grill a high-level design
